name: dsh-retrace
description: Retrace · 回溯 — Recall, edit-and-resend, regenerate, and conversation/artifact versioning (timeline, rollback, fork map) for DeepSeek Harness — Web and Desktop

scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-dynamic.mjs && node scripts/check-host-contract.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/check-pkg-meta.mjs && pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm test

author: OfferKuai <contact@offerkuai.com> (https://www.offerkuai.com)
//dependencies: The six @deepseek-ai packages are deliberately listed BOTH here and in peerDependencies. The peers carry the host-generation gate (dsh-app-boot's evaluatePluginCompatibility reads peerDependencies only), but peers are NOT installed into a DSH profile (profiles set autoInstallPeers:false) — and this plugin statically imports foldSurface / deriveEventMessage / SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION and defineDomain / domainTable, so a registry or GitHub install would otherwise fail to load with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (a local link: install hides this, because it uses the plugin's own node_modules). cordis, dsh-scope, dsh-invariants and dsh-storage are the transitive PEER closure of dsh-session and dsh-storage-domain, which load them at module top level. All of them are pure/structural where this plugin uses them — defineDomain validates and returns the same spec object — so a second copy beside the host's is safe.
